title: It Just Don´t Feel Like Christmac (without You)
original_lyrics:
[chorus]
Another day, another reminder that your not here with me
I watch the snowflakes falling from the sky then I get lost in memories
The time we tried to build snowman
The time we tried to count the stars
Its crazy how we didn know then
That we ever be apart
I can hear the music playing
See the lights upon the tree
I can feel the joy in every soul

[bridge]
And I try my best to play the part, but no matter what I do
No, it just don feel like Christmas without you, you
Another tear, another regret boy, that you so far away

[chorus]
Remember when we took the sleigh ride
Remember singing by the fire
There to much that in the daylight
I keep reliving you and I
I can hear the music playing
See the lights upon the tree
I can feel the joy in every soul

[bridge]
And I try my best to play the part, but no matter what I do
No, it just don feel like Christmas without you
The time we tried to build snowman
The time we tried to count the stars
Its crazy how we didn know then
That we ever be apart
I can hear the music playing
See the lights upon the tree
I can feel the joy in every soul

[bridge]
And I try my best to play the part, but no matter what I do
No, it just don feel like Christmas without you, ooh baby
See I tried but it just ain right, right without you.
